title: GTA 6 Interactive Map Update: 2,700+ Markers & Account System
description: With GTA 6 two weeks away, a community interactive map has received a major update featuring over 2,700 Leonida markers, user accounts, and official map integration plans.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Interactive Map Receives Major Pre-Launch Update

With Grand Theft Auto VI just two weeks away from its highly anticipated release, the community hype is reaching a fever pitch. While waiting for final Rockstar details, dedicated fans continue to deliver incredible community-driven projects. Recently on the r/GTA6 Reddit community, developer /u/kalterapfel123 shared a substantial update on their interactive map project, designed to help players navigate the streets of Leonida and Vice City right from day one.

Having grown significantly over the past few months, the interactive tool aims to be an indispensable companion for players exploring the game at launch. Here is a breakdown of what is currently available:

* **Over 2,700 Markers**: Precisely positioned map markers spanning across Leonida and Vice City.
* **Search & Filter Tools**: Fully searchable locations, categorized filters, and marker previews.
* **Mobile Improvements**: Enhanced mobile interface and smooth map navigation.
* **Personalization**: Personal map settings and customized view options.
* **User Accounts**: Feature-rich user accounts allowing players to save favorites and track visited locations, along with shareable links to individual markers.

## Looking Ahead: Official Map Integration and Layer Comparison

Looking forward past the game's release, the project has ambitious plans. The team is currently preparing a brand-new map layer system.

The long-term plan is to integrate the official Leonida map after GTA 6 launches, while thoughtfully keeping the incredible community reconstruction map—crafted by Yanis and the GTA VI Mapping community—available as an optional layer.

Furthermore, transparency controls are in development to allow players to eventually overlay the community and official maps for a direct side-by-side comparison. A GTA V comparison layer is also undergoing testing. Naturally, the success of this final integration will depend heavily on the official map data and how everything aligns.

The developer is currently asking for community feedback to iron out bugs, streamline confusing menus, and test mobile performance. Players are welcome to create a free account to test saving favorite and visited locations.

Credit for the current artwork goes to Yanis V17 and the dedicated members of the GTA VI Mapping community, whose tireless reconstruction work forms the backbone of the project, with the developer building the interactive tools and databases around it.

### Editor's Take
This community-built interactive map highlights the unmatched dedication of the GTA fanbase. By transforming community-sourced reconstructions into a functional, feature-rich tool with user accounts and upcoming official comparison layers, this project proves once again that the player community is ready to conquer Leonida together.
